Enable auto-accelerate in Mario Kart settings first. This option only hides the A pedal; it does not hold A or change game settings. Brake and other controls remain visible. Select Classic controller for menus, photo mode or additional controls.

The letters identify the actual controller inputs. Symbols are an editable visual preset; sword, shield and item bindings have not yet been verified in the remake. Changing a symbol does not equip an item or remap its button.

The 40th anniversary controls show the controller letters: the game decides what each button does. Sword, shield and item bindings have not yet been verified in the remake. Symbols chosen for the earlier Zelda artwork are kept, but not shown.
